instruction: Candid medium shot of four martial artists posing in front of a red brick wall. From left to right, a young girl in a red gi (R3) tilts her head and smiles, a girl with braided hair (R4), a boy with light brown hair (R2), and a blonde woman (R1) all stand side-by-side, looking at the camera with bright smiles. Their arms are wrapped around each other's shoulders in a warm group pose. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the natural indoor setting.
